name: rs-cad
description: These are the **offline** scripts that turned `assets/reBot_B601_RS_v1.0_20260625.step` into the per-link GLBs and `assets/rs/manifest.json` that ship in the app. They are *not* loaded by the browser and have no bearing on the runtime (no build step is added to RoboForge). Re-run them only when the CAD changes.
